subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: Under -O4 with peephole off, three or more same-spelled `*(T*)((u8*)p + OFF)` accesses whose span crosses calls make MWCC materialize the address `p + OFF` into a saved GPR (address-PRE web). Respelling the accesses as a named struct member (`p->field`) lowers them to plain base+displacement loads/stores and removes the web. Applied at scale (~17 named Player fields) this removed every `addi rS,r31,disp` saved-register web in PlayerMotion and drove fuzzy 95.08% to 97.13% while shrinking stmw r15 to r16 and the frame 656 to 648.

attributes.scope: cflags_demo -O4 no-peephole game code; measured on src/game/game/pmotion.c
attributes.caveat: Where the target reloads a value per use across a call, member spelling can over-CSE to one load (atree 0x790 case); check the target's reload count per site.
